sections.content: You know *es importante que*, *es necesario que* and *es mejor que* + the present subjunctive from A2 Unit 27: a judgement about what should happen takes the subjunctive. Here they give what officials, the elite or historians think. Keep the main clause in the present: it is a view, not a past event.

items.spanish: Para los funcionarios es importante que cada persona tenga un lugar en la lista.
items.english: For the officials it is important that each person has a place on the list.

items.spanish: Es necesario que el registro diga el origen de la familia.
items.english: It is necessary that the register states the family's origin.

items.spanish: Para la élite es mejor que las categorías no cambien.
items.english: For the elite it is better that the categories do not change.

items.spanish: Para muchos historiadores es importante que hoy se estudie esta historia.
items.english: For many historians it is important that this history is studied today.

sections.content: The verb after *que* is in the present subjunctive (*tenga*, *diga*, *cambien*, *se estudie*). If nobody in particular is meant, use the infinitive instead: *es importante estudiar esta historia*.
